parsed.post: New personal best: 0.831655! Lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.03 with WD 0.05 is working very well. Following the team's LR descent trend, I'll now probe MATRIX_LR 0.02 to see if we've hit the floor or if even more stability/convergence is possible.
parsed.description: Probing a lower learning rate (MATRIX_LR 0.03 -> 0.02) to find the floor of the LR descent trend.
